## Professional Experience

### 1. Ternak Klip — Backend Engineer
- **Tenure**: June 2026 – Present
- **Location**: Jakarta, Indonesia
- **Key Responsibilities & Impact**:
  - Developing and maintaining core application backend microservices with Go for a platform serving over 500,000 active users, ensuring high concurrency, scalability, and system reliability.
  - Architecting internal operational tooling, data pipelines, and automation workflows to streamline team productivity.
- **Technologies**: Go (Golang), REST APIs, Microservices, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, CI/CD.

### 2. OPPO Manufacturing Indonesia — Software Engineer / Web Developer Intern
- **Tenure**: August 2025 – January 2026
- **Location**: Tangerang, Banten, Indonesia
- **Key Responsibilities & Impact**:
  - Built **Ollie Chatbot**: HR assistant integrating FaceNet biometric facial recognition, custom Indonesian xTTS synthesis, OpenAI Whisper STT, and Faiss RAG.
  - Engineered **5S AI Camera**: Real-time industrial computer vision inspection system using ConvNeXt, PyTorch, Ollama Gemma Vision, LLaVA VLM, and OwlViT for automated 5S compliance monitoring.
  - Developed **5Why AI Application**: Root Cause Analysis diagnostic platform leveraging dense-sparse RAG with Faiss, MiniLM, and DeepSeek LLMs.
- **Technologies**: Python, PyTorch, Transformers, FaceNet, Faiss, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui.

### 3. Aether AI — AI Engineer Intern
- **Tenure**: March 2025 – June 2025
- **Location**: Jakarta, Indonesia
- **Key Responsibilities & Impact**:
  - Designed and deployed AI chatbots for the Indonesian Consulate General in New York (KJRI New York / Maleo AI) and Produksi Film Negara (PFN) utilizing Vectorshift, GPT, and FastAPI.
- **Technologies**: Python, FastAPI, Vectorshift, OpenAI GPT, RAG.

### 4. Avatar Digital — Backend Developer Intern
- **Tenure**: December 2024 – February 2025
- **Location**: Jakarta, Indonesia
- **Key Responsibilities & Impact**:
  - Developed parcel shipment and administrative backend APIs for JNE Self Kiosk using Go (Labstack Echo) and MySQL/MariaDB.
- **Technologies**: Go (Labstack Echo), MySQL, REST APIs, Git.

### 5. BEM UI & BEM Fasilkom UI — Head of Development & Backend Lead
- **Tenure**: February 2024 – December 2025
- **Location**: Depok, Indonesia

- **Technologies**: Django, Go (Gin), Firebase, PostgreSQL, Railway, LINE Messaging API.

## Featured AI & Software Projects

- **[RAGReader](https://github.com/thirza258/RagReader)**: Evaluation & benchmarking platform for custom Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines. Uses Django REST Framework, Celery, ChromaDB, LangChain, OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, Cross-Encoder MiniLM-L2 reranker, and React. (Demo: https://rag.nevatal.id/ | Devpost: https://devpost.com/software/ragreader-kauodp)
- **[Multi-Hop Corrective with Reranker RAG Pipeline (CRAG)](https://www.nevatal.id/#portfolio)**: Multi-hop reasoning framework combining Hybrid Retrieval (Dense + Sparse), Corrective RAG (CRAG) evaluation to eliminate hallucinations, ChromaDB, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, RAGAs, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery.
- **[Nevatal](https://github.com/thirza258/nevatal)**: Full-stack AI workspace integrating Google Gemini prompt orchestration, document RAG, text utilities, and image generation. Built for Google Chrome Built-in AI Challenge 2025. (Demo: https://chat.nevatal.id/ | Devpost: https://devpost.com/software/chattywhole)
- **[Ollie Chatbot](https://www.nevatal.id/#portfolio)**: HR & employee assistant for OPPO Manufacturing Indonesia. Features FaceNet facial verification, custom Indonesian xTTS text-to-speech, local OpenAI Whisper STT, and Faiss/PostgreSQL RAG.
- **[5S AI Camera](https://www.nevatal.id/#portfolio)**: Computer vision compliance system for OPPO Manufacturing Indonesia using ConvNeXt, PyTorch, Ollama Gemma Vision, LLaVA VLM, and OwlViT for real-time factory 5S inspection.
- **[5Why AI Application](https://www.nevatal.id/#portfolio)**: Root Cause Analysis engine automating the "5 Whys" methodology for OPPO Manufacturing Indonesia using Dense & Sparse RAG, Faiss, MiniLM, Deepseek LLMs, and FastAPI.
- **[Pasal Voice Assistant](https://www.nevatal.id/#portfolio)**: Completely self-hosted, privacy-first voice assistant with Indonesian TTS/STT, Gemma 3, Ollama GemmaEmbedding, and ChromaDB.
- **[KJRI New York Chatbot (Maleo AI)](https://www.nevatal.id/#portfolio)**: Consulate-services AI chatbot for Indonesian Consulate General in New York using GPT, RAG, Vectorshift, and FastAPI.
- **[PFN Chatbot](https://www.nevatal.id/#portfolio)**: Film metadata and documentation retrieval assistant for Produksi Film Negara (PFN) using Vectorshift, GPT, and RAG.
- **[URL Shortener](https://github.com/thirza258/freecodecamp_url_shortener)**: Production-grade short link platform with Redis rate-limiting, click analytics, and PostgreSQL. (Demo: https://url.nevatal.id/)
- **[ChattyDesk](https://www.nevatal.id/#portfolio)**: Cross-platform desktop app for multi-LLM workflows (Gemini, Claude, GPT, Mistral) built with Electron, React, TypeScript, and Django REST Framework.
- **[Integrated Information Systems (SIT)](https://www.nevatal.id/#portfolio)**: Enterprise management portal and LINE Bot for BEM Universitas Indonesia with Django, Firebase, and Railway.
- **[SiInven](https://www.nevatal.id/#portfolio)**: Enterprise inventory management platform built with Java Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Docker, React, and Tailwind CSS.
- **[JNE Self Kiosk Backend](https://www.nevatal.id/#portfolio)**: Parcel self-service delivery backend service built with Go (Labstack Echo) and GitHub Actions CI/CD.

- **AI / Machine Learning / LLMs**: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Corrective RAG (CRAG), GraphRAG, AI Agents, LangChain, ChromaDB, Faiss, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Ollama, Whisper STT, TTS (xTTS / MMS), ConvNeXt, OwlViT, Computer Vision.
- **Frontend Development**: React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Vite, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Material-UI, Vue.js, Electron.
- **DevOps & Infrastructure**: Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Linux, Railway, Vercel, AWS Amplify, Azure Cloud, MinIO, SonarQube, Cloudflare Tunnels.
